Film 'Jana Nayagan' Box Office Collections Show Weekend Boost

The Tamil film 'Jana Nayagan', starring Vijay, experienced a weekend boost in its domestic box office collections. On its tenth day, the movie earned Rs 0.63 crore, bringing its total India net collection to Rs 184.19 crore. While the film saw a dip in daily collections on its eighth day, its second weekend performance indicated continued audience interest.
